rows.heading_en: Warning on Strong Wind and Rough Seas
rows.text_en: SECTION A: FOR MALAYSIAN WATERS [WITHIN 24 NAUTICAL MILES] 1) LOW HORIZONTAL VISIBILITY WARNING Low horizontal visibility is expected over the waters of Selangor • N. Sembilan • Melaka • Johor • Western Sarawak • Lahad Datu until Monday, 19 October 2026. 2) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Perlis & Kedah • Penang • Perak • Selangor • N. Sembilan • Melaka • Johor • Pahang • Terengganu • Sarawak • Sabah until 6:00 PM; Monday, 19 October 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats. SECTION B: FOR SHIPPING 1) THUNDERSTORMS WARNING Thunderstorms, heavy rain and strong winds are expected over the waters of Phuket • Samui • Bunguran • Reef South • Reef North • Condore • Labuan • Palawan • Straits Of Melaka • Tioman • Layang-Layang • Sulu • Sulawesi until 6:00 PM; Monday, 19 October 2026. This condition may cause strong winds up to 50 kmph and rough seas with wave height up to 3.5 metres and is dangerous to small boats.
rows.instruction_en: This condition of strong winds and rough seas is dangerous.
